profile.headline: Data & Insights - Geospatial Application Software Engineer at Chevron | MSc. in Geoscience - GIST - Geographic Information Science & Technology
profile.summary:
I am an analytical and forward-thinking professional with 9+ years of computational geoscience experience, paired with a Master-level education in Geographical Information Systems and Technology. 

Throughout my career, I've combined my extensive field experience with advance knowledge in GIS programming, spatial analysis, and modeling to develop insightful maps and other data visualizations to support strategic operational planning. 

I also effectively liaise with laboratory personnel and other relevant project teams to define project specifications and ensure overall compliance with established quality and safety regulations.

Technical Acumen: 

Programming Languages: C# | HTML | CSS | JAVA Script | Python | SQL Server | Visual Basic | Linux | Microchip PIC Assembly | PERI | CGI-Scripting | LATEX | Git Extensions | GitHub

Software & Packages: ESRI GIS Software | ArcGIS Online| ArcGIS Pro | ArcMap | Arcpy | ArcCollector | Petrel | PRCAD | Cisco IOS | SQL | Java | MS Office Suite | Power BI | Power Automate |Power App | PSpice | Arcpy | SciPy | NumPy | Flask | Cobol | GeoNas | NetGas | GAX | GWM | Nexus | GRS | FME | Tabasco Spotfire | Petrel | Digital Twin Esri | Esri AI Assistant | GeoAI | Azure DevOp | Databricks |

Algorithm Development Environment: MATLAB | LABVIEW | MPLAB X IDE | GrayMag

Training: CodeCademy | QSHE Core Day I & III | T-HUET | H2S Training | Rig Pass | OPEC Rig Pass SafeLand & SafeGulf | Fit Test | TWIC Card

positions.title: Geospatial Data Analyst
positions.description:
Utilize analytic tools to capture ongoing engagement data visualizations
Acquire data from primary or secondary data sources and build and maintain analytics dashboards, maps, and applications. Utilize Esri, E&P, and Microsoft Azure Cloud platform products and cloud services to process and handle and analyze structured and unstructured data.
Provide support to all data analysis for overall marketing performance measurement.
Expand business acumen and network through close partnership with various business units and users of the GIS Technology Platform and develop leadership skills by leading projects with the GIS Team’s application upgrades working with our Managed Service Provider.


Perform advance digital solution for business units using an array of software on job and training requisites, not limited to ArcGIS Pro, Petrel, Spofire, Power BI, Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse, Advance FME, Python, R, and SQL/NoSQL queries operations and migration of datasets to Azure Cloud.

positions.title: GSS Data Analyst
positions.description:
Automate ETL and ELT process across multiple oil and gas drilling well data from a mobile laboratory in offshore drilling sites, adhering to all safety regulation onsite while running algorithms and interpreting data, which reduce manual workload monthly. Liaises with laboratory personnel to break down and evaluate rock and gas characteristics, determining optimal pay zones for presentation to senior leadership and key stakeholders.

Perform advance digital solution for oil and gas production using an array of software on job and training requisites, not limited to Geographics, Techlog Python, Petrel, and SQL/NoSQL queries operations.

Inspects, cleanse, transform, and model oil and gas data with the goal of discovering useful information, informing conclusions, and supporting decision-making during drilling operations.

Maintain well data integrity and reliability, designs and processes detailed daily and end of well reports based on the data gathered during well operations.

positions.title: Data Engineer, Remote Geographic Location Assigned Laboratory
positions.description: Performed ETL process across billions of oil and gas data at laboratory, and offshore drilling sites, adhering to all safety regulation onsite while running algorithms and interpreting data, which reduce manual workload by 23% monthly. Liaises with laboratory personnel to break down and evaluate rock and gas characteristics, determining optimal pay zones for presentation to senior leadership and key stakeholders.

positions.title: Wellsite Geologist I-IV, Remote Graphic Location - Onshore
positions.description:
I collected, analyzed, and identified drilled cuttings and formation tops to direct oil and gas operations, visualizing data via various software to maximize drilling capability while maintaining compliance to established health and safety standards. I developed new Excel processes to automate obsolete part replacement, resulting in 26% increase in oil production rate.

Examined oil & gas data, processes and technologies to evaluate current state and critical problems. Research and make recommendations about training, equipment, and technology to improve data use. created automated data reports to inform business units, including documentation and invoices.

positions.title: Energy Consultant
positions.description: Consult with clients to investigate, understand, and oversee the installation of renewable energy systems, while increasing efficiency and reduce cost and mitigate environmental impact. Research renewable energy saving alternatives appropriate for the client’s needs. Converted several energy packages such as natural gas, fossil fuel, wind, solar, hydroelectric, geothermal, biomass, hydrogen into sales for residential and commercial cliental.

projects.title: Badlands, SD, Bighorn Canyon, MT, Elk Basin Oil Field,
projects.description:
• Performed scientific observation and geologic problem-solving in the field through the application of suitable geologic mapping techniques by acquiring familiarity with geologic, physiographic, and natural resource features of the region.

• Developed and strengthened skills in preparing stratigraphic sections, scientific reports, and maps based on daily research and investigation while expanding practical experience with GPS including mapping on portable computers with ARCMAP and PDA pocket computer with ARCPAD.

projects.title: Fossils and Stratigraphy of the Upper Ordovician Standard in SE, IN
projects.description:
• Studied the paleogeography of the region including reconstructed storm tracks and possible routes for sediment transport from the Taconic Orogen. 

• Observed the sequence stratigraphic interpretation of Cincinnatian lithostratigraphic units and encountered fossils including Brachiopods, Bryozoans, Cephalopods, Corals, Echinoderms, Snails, Strophomenate, and Trilobites.
